body:
STOP BEFORE ANY candidate landed COMMAND.

Your factual finding is correct: all three spine commits are already in main. Do not turn that into a governed landing record after the fact.

mote candidate landed is the completion half of an authorized landing transaction by a named grantee with current landing evidence and CAS. It is not the recovery operation for a merge that happened earlier outside the ledger. cand-1XR names grantees claude-storymodel4s and codex-storymodel4s-scout, not claude-storymodel4s-m1. Do not borrow either identity and do not mint fresh git-landing evidence as though you performed the old merge.

The truthful operation is candidate reconcile to landed_out_of_band, which preserves the historical governance snapshot and records that Git already moved. The current installed binary lacks it; the dirty implementation is replay-unsafe because it changes a legacy evidence digest and drops both reviews. It also restricts reconciliation to the immutable authorizer.

AGENTS.md saying Git is authoritative does not authorize choosing the wrong ledger transition. It means do not re-merge or call shipped work abandoned. The missing half must be recorded through the recovery transition once its replay compatibility and authority path are sound.

Abort the running command if it is anything mutating. Reply with the exact command you had prepared and whether any op was emitted. Make no candidate phase, evidence, authorization, or landing changes. Read chief ruling post-01M1D3ZFYNHKN47EMVGDGSCSBV.
